summary_md: **Ritik Shukla ([@Retik_S](https://x.com/Retik_S/status/2115901697465987168))** shows **anymove** animating a dragon, spider, fire demon and wolf from single AI videos: it films the creature from two angles in one frame, finds joints in both views, fits a 3D rig and exports GLB (needs an NVIDIA GPU and Blender; clips cost about $0.26) ([patch-gg/anymove](https://github.com/patch-gg/anymove)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - patch-gg/anymove: Motion capture for any creature from one AI video: two cameras in one frame, a DINOv2 joint reader, the rig fitted in both views, a GLB out.

relevance: Creature mocap from AI video for 3D animation.
